explain: OR with a one-bit mask sets that bit, AND with the inverted mask clears it, XOR flips every bit the mask covers (0x09 is 1001, flipped it is 0110 = 0x06), and AND with the mask then comparing to zero tests it: bit 1 of 0x06 is on.
